about: Things the world can do that the player is rewarded for finding, once each. essence = reward. hint = shown (greyed) before it is found, in the Grimoire's Discoveries page. Raised by the sim through api.discover(id).

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.text: Water met lava and it set into black glass.
obsidian.hint: What happens when water meets lava?

steam.name: Steam
steam.text: Heat boiled water into a white cloud.

glass.name: Glassmaking
glass.hint: Sand can take a lot of heat... or a bolt.

doused.name: Doused
doused.text: Water ran over a flame and put it out.

frozen-lava.name: Stopped flow
frozen-lava.text: Frost turned lava straight to stone.
frozen-lava.hint: Cold can stop a lava flow.

frozen-flame.name: Frozen flame
frozen-flame.text: Frostfire turned water to ice where it touched.

quench.name: Fire against fire
quench.text: Frostfire and flame put each other out.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.hint: What does bile do to stone?

diluted.name: Watered down
diluted.text: Bile mixed with water and lost its bite.

purified.name: Purified
purified.text: Blessed water made something foul clean again.

bog-flare.name: Bog flare
bog-flare.text: Bog goo flashed in the heat.

pitch-fire.name: Pitch fire
pitch-fire.text: Pitch caught from the lava and roared.

sapling.name: Sapling
sapling.text: A seed drank and became a tree.

arcane-burst.name: Arcane burst
arcane-burst.text: Mana crystal went off like a star.
arcane-burst.hint: Mana crystal does not like lightning.

unmaking.name: Unmaking
unmaking.text: Blessed water and void cancelled each other in a flash.

spore-cloud.name: Spore cloud
spore-cloud.text: A burning glowcap burst into spores.

spore-flash.name: Spore flash
spore-flash.text: A cloud of spores caught fire all at once.
spore-flash.hint: Spores are dust... and dust burns.

marsh-flare.name: Marsh flare
marsh-flare.hint: Something rises from a marsh at night.

restless-bones.name: Restless bones
restless-bones.text: Bog goo woke a pile of bones.

chain-blast.name: Chain blast
chain-blast.hint: Light one end of a trail of blackpowder.

void.name: The void hungers
void.text: Voidseed ate the land around it.

charged-water.name: Charged water
charged-water.text: Lightning ran through a whole pool.

steam-crater.name: Steam crater
steam-crater.text: A meteor fell into water and boiled it.
steam-crater.hint: Drop a meteor into a lake.

drowned.name: In over their heads
drowned.text: Something that cannot swim found deep water.

troll-stone.name: Sunrise
troll-stone.text: A troll caught by the dawn turned to stone.

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.text: A phoenix burned away and came back.
rebirth.hint: What happens when a phoenix falls?

chain-four.name: Four in a row
chain-four.hint: Line up some foes for the chain.

sunstone.name: Sunstone
sunstone.text: Blessed water cooled lava into sunstone.

flung.name: Hand of the sky
flung.text: You picked something up and threw it.

hatchling.name: Hatchling
hatchling.text: A wyrm egg kept warm in lava cracked open.
